== Summary ==
Published-layout comparison for [[Suppressive Fire (V) (Errata 3)]]. Left: [[:File:V8-L-suppressivefire.gif]], with exterior top padding cropped. Right: [[:File:V8-L-suppressivefire-Set8-June-2023-partial.png]], using its original PDF mask. Card pixels were not repainted or completed; blank surroundings are comparison-canvas background. Original source [[:File:Virtual-Set-8-June-2023.pdf]], page 6. Lucasfilm Ltd.; original images published by the Players Committee.
